name: São Paulo/Guarulhos - Governador André Franco Montoro International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 10L/28R 3,700 m × 45 m and 10R/28L 3,000 m × 45 m, asphalt

ppr.v: general aviation, including air taxi, must coordinate the flight in advance with the airport: 6 hours ahead for wingspan up to 24 m, 24 hours ahead for wingspan up to 65 m
ppr.quote: As ACFT da aviação geral (inclusive TAX aéreo) deverão COOR previamente

max_aircraft.v: general aviation parks only on apron 12, with authorisation from the operations control centre, for at most 2 hours on the ground; maximum ground time 3 hours for international and 2 hours for domestic flights; taxiways S, T and U closed to aircraft larger than a B-707; TWY A (between G and apron 1) and V limited to 65 m wingspan
max_aircraft.quote: Tempo MAX de permanência no GND, FLT INTL 03 HR e FLT DOM 02 HR.

hours.v: turboprop and piston aircraft may not land or take off 0930-1300 and 2200-0200 UTC (06:30-10:00 and 19:00-23:00 local, UTC-3), except military, medevac and RBAC 121/129 operators; this rule does not apply to jets
hours.quote: AD PRB OPS LDG e TKOF BTN 0930-1300 e 2200-0200 de ACFT Turboélices e Pistão EXC ACFT MIL,

handling.v: General aviation, including air taxi, must tell the airport when coordinating which airport-accredited handling company will look after the aircraft, and what means are available to remove the aircraft after an incident or accident; a tow fork is mandatory. No handler is named
handling.quote: Empresa de handling credenciada no AP responsável pelo atendimento da ACFT

notes: 28 Oct 2026: DECEA eAIP AD 2 SBGR (AIRAC A 13-2026) gave a server error on 28 Oct 2026; full AIP PDFs were binary. 1 Nov 2026: read the DECEA AISWEB ROTAER entry for SBGR (D-AMDT 26/26; header 'AD INTL PUB/MIL GRU Airport 24/NE UTC-3'). Added runway, ppr (coordination), max_aircraft (parking and ground time) and hours (turboprop/piston restriction). ROTAER times are UTC; local times are my conversion with UTC-3 (Brazil has no summer time). Parking quote in full: 'PRKG de ACFT da aviação civil geral somente no pátio NR 12 e mediante AUTH do centro de controle operacional' ... 'permanência MAX no solo 2HR.' Coordination contact in ROTAER: ag.coa@gru.com.br. Fixed-wing VFR flight plans to or from SBGR are prohibited (except Brazilian military); flight plans may not be filed by radio. Training flights prohibited. The entry shows 'AD INTL' but no customs hours, and no fuel line; '24/NE' is not explained, so customs and curfew are not recorded. 'GRU Airport' is the operator's name, not stated as IATA code. Owner should download the current eAIP AD 2 SBGR from AISWEB for customs and fuel. | 3 Nov 2026: re-read ROTAER (D-AMDT 26/26, AISWEB AMDT 44/26). Apron item 04 says 'AUTH voos de carga e voos não regulares somente 0300/0900' and '1500/2100' (UTC), without the page read making clear which apron or whether charters are affected: ask the airport (ag.coa@gru.com.br) when coordinating. No customs, fuel, or slot text. Could not be read: eAIP AD 2 SBGR A 13-2026 (https://aisweb.decea.mil.br/eaip/A%2013-2026_2026_07_09/eAIP/AD%202%20SBGR-en-GB.html, site error); ANAC GRU capacity declaration W26 (https://www.gov.br/anac/pt-br/assuntos/regulados/empresas-aereas/slot/aeroportos/GRU/declaracao-de-capacidade/Declaracao_de_Capacidade_GRU_W26.pdf, human check page), so whether GA needs a slot is not verified. ANAC Resolution 682/2022 leaves the modalities that must request slots to each airport's declaration. ROTAER Cap 1-2 (25 May 2017) does not explain '24/NE'.
